name: Light Green | Self-Adhesive Wall-Mounted Luxury Soap Holder with Lid and Drainage Tray
description:
Upgrade your bathroom or kitchen with the Self-Adhesive Wall-Mounted Luxury Soap Holder in elegant Milky & Light Green. This sleek and practical design keeps your soap dry, clean, and protected with its flip lid and drainage tray system. Made from durable waterproof ABS plastic, it installs easily on any smooth surface without drilling or tools. Its dust-proof and space-saving design makes it ideal for modern homes, ensuring your soap lasts longer while keeping your space tidy and stylish.Key Features:
 Elegant Milky & Light Green color combination
 Self-adhesive, drill-free installation for convenience
 Flip cover keeps soap protected from dust and splashes
 Built-in drainage tray prevents water buildup
 Made from high-quality waterproof ABS plastic
 Space-saving, durable, and easy to clean
 Suitable for bathroom, kitchen, and wash basin useHow to Use:
 Clean and dry the surface before applying
 Peel off the adhesive backing and press firmly on the wall
 Allow it to set for a few hours before placing the soap
 Lift flip cover to access or replace soap easilyMaterial:
High-quality waterproof ABS plasticSafety Information:
 Install on smooth, non-porous surfaces only
 Avoid overloading or placing heavy items
 Clean regularly to prevent soap buildup

Package Includes:
 1 × Self-Adhesive Wall-Mounted Luxury Soap Holder with Lid (Light Green)
